# Strava

> > Strava is a social fitness platform for athletes to track, analyze, and share running, cycling, hiking, and walking activities with a global community.

Strava combines GPS activity tracking with community features, route planning, and training tools across multiple sports. The platform serves both individual athletes and offers B2B wellness partnerships for organizations.

## Key Topics

- Activity Tracking
- GPS Tracking
- Route Planning
- Running
- Cycling
- Hiking
- Walking
- Community Features
- Training Tips
- Fitness Goals
- Progress Analysis
- Running Challenges
- Cycling Challenges
- Fitness Motivation
- Machine Learning

## Core Sports & Activities

- [Running App - Explore Run Maps, Route Planner & Tracker | Strava](https://www.strava.com/sports/running): Strava running app with route planning, tracking, and community features
- [Cycling & Biking App - Tracker, Trails, Training & More | Strava](https://www.strava.com/sports/cycling): Strava cycling app for trail discovery, progress tracking, and training
- [Hiking App - Explore Hiking Trails, Tracking (GPS) & Share | Strava](https://www.strava.com/sports/hiking): Strava hiking app with GPS tracking, trail exploration, and sharing
- [Walking App - Walk Tracker, Explore Trails & Share | Strava](https://www.strava.com/sports/walking): Strava walking app with trail exploration and activity logging features

## Subscriptions & Membership

- [Strava Subscription](https://www.strava.com/subscribe): Strava premium subscription plans with training and family options
- [Subscription Partnerships](https://business.strava.com/subscription-partnerships): Strava B2B subscription partnerships for corporate wellness programs
